body:
I had used Kratom several times before with some interesting and relaxing results, but never put much thought into it for quite some time. Around 2 years ago, I broke a finger and as a result have severe arthritis in that hand. This was extremely devastating to me as I am a professional musician- guitarist, lutenist, and pianist. Playing my instruments became difficult and I had to adjust my technique to accommodate the pain.
I visited a few doctors, all of which told me to take over-the-counter pain relievers to combat the arthritis. These medicines had little effect, they would dull the pain, but it was still there. I've also read that many of these OTC pain relievers such as acetaminophen can have harmful effects from prolonged use.
Then I remembered Kratom. I was desperate to get rid of the pain as it had worsened and was hurting my career as a musician. I purchased 4 oz of Powdered Maeng Da Kratom in hopes that it could help.
And...it helps!
Here's what I do-
-put 6 grams of powdered Kratom in a small pot on the stove.
-add 2 cups of water
-heat on LOW for 15 minutes
-remove from heat and let steep for 30-80 minutes
-filter in a French press
-drink the tea
I begin feeling the effects within 20 minutes and I am pain free for about 6 hours. Kratom has allowed me to focus on playing my instruments once again, and the happy mellow mood it gives me is pretty nice as well.
The taste is bitter, almost identical to Yerba Mate tea. I like it!
